## Native reading

This fictional page exercises ordinary HTML, a [native destination](#details),
and mathematics $x^2 + y^2 = z^2$. The audit observes final bytes and leaves them
unchanged. No policy is delivered to the browser.

::: {.callout-note}
Inline script/style hashes are candidates for review, not automatic permission.
:::
